verdict.rationale: Zapier documents multiple programmatic access surfaces for AI-native use: a Workflow API, an official SDK/CLI (npm install, OAuth handling), and an MCP server with governed connection tokens, plus a discoverable llms.txt index confirming developer docs are machine-readable. This directly satisfies driving the product via documented public APIs for agentic/AI-native workflows. missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s), and independent third-party/hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows beyond vendor docs.
